health_thresholds.name: Miner health thresholds
health_thresholds.description: Auto profile picks thresholds by manufacturer and model (starting recommendations — verify for your firmware). Number fields below apply only when profile is Custom.

data.hashrate_low_ratio: Low hashrate ratio (see profile: Auto = learned baseline, Generic/Custom = ideal hashrate from miner)

data_description.health_profile: Auto uses built-in profiles by make/model. Generic uses universal defaults. Custom uses the numbers below.
data_description.temp_chip_warn_c: Chip junction temperature: partial score reduction starts here. Meaning varies by firmware and hardware.
data_description.temp_chip_high_c: Chip temperature critical: triggers High temperature and Attention required.
data_description.temp_board_warn_c: PCB/board temperature warning — usually lower than chip limits.
data_description.hashrate_low_ratio: Auto profile: fraction of learned baseline hashrate for this power mode. Generic/Custom: fraction of ideal hashrate reported by the miner.
data_description.chip_low_percent: Minimum effective chips per board (%). Evaluated only while mining.
data_description.reject_rate_high_pct: Pool reject rate (%) above which scoring penalizes the miner.
data_description.share_stale_seconds: No accepted share for this long while mining reduces the score.
data_description.power_low_ratio: Consumption below reference × this ratio triggers a power anomaly. Before baseline is learned, reference is power limit; after learning, reference is baseline for the current mode.
data_description.power_high_ratio: Consumption above reference × this ratio triggers a power anomaly. Before baseline is learned, reference is power limit; after learning, reference is baseline for the current mode.

repair_timing.name: Repair timing
repair_timing.description: Default warning delay applies to most repairs. Advanced per-type overrides below; temperature and offline keep safer built-in defaults unless you set them explicitly.

data_description.repair_confirm_default_seconds: How long a condition must persist before a repair appears (most types). Default 300 s (5 min).
data_description.repair_recovery_seconds: How long the condition must stay normal before the repair clears. Default 240 s (4 min).
data_description.repair_confirm_temperature_seconds: Optional override for critical temperature repairs (default 180 s if unset).
data_description.repair_confirm_offline_seconds: Optional override for offline repairs (default 600 s if unset).

auto_recovery.name: Automatic recovery
auto_recovery.description: Optional hashrate recovery via software reboot and, if explicitly enabled, a linked power switch. Disabled by default. Uses the hashrate threshold from health settings above.

data_description.auto_recovery_enabled: Off by default. Only attempts recovery when hashrate stays below the configured threshold.
data_description.auto_recovery_power_cycle_enabled: Requires a linked smart switch and explicit consent. Never enabled automatically.
data_description.auto_recovery_pre_action_seconds: How long low hashrate must persist before any action (default 600 s).
data_description.auto_recovery_cooldown_seconds: After any completed recovery (success or lock), block further auto recovery (default 21600 s = 6 h).

data_description.pool_action: Leave unchanged, replace the primary slot, or add a backup (max 3 pools).
data_description.pool_password: Leave empty if the pool does not require a password.

data.hashrate_low_ratio: Low hashrate ratio (see profile: Auto = learned baseline, Generic/Custom = ideal hashrate from miner)

data_description.temp_chip_warn_c: Chip junction temperature: partial score reduction starts here. Meaning varies by firmware and hardware.
data_description.temp_chip_high_c: Chip temperature critical: triggers High temperature and Attention required.
data_description.temp_board_warn_c: PCB/board temperature warning — usually lower than chip limits.
data_description.hashrate_low_ratio: Auto profile: fraction of learned baseline hashrate for this power mode. Generic/Custom: fraction of ideal hashrate reported by the miner.

data_description.reject_rate_high_pct: Pool reject rate (%) above which scoring penalizes the miner.
data_description.share_stale_seconds: No accepted share for this long while mining reduces the score.
data_description.power_low_ratio: Consumption below reference × this ratio triggers a power anomaly. Before baseline is learned, reference is power limit; after learning, reference is baseline for the current mode.
data_description.power_high_ratio: Consumption above reference × this ratio triggers a power anomaly. Before baseline is learned, reference is power limit; after learning, reference is baseline for the current mode.
data_description.repair_confirm_default_seconds: How long a condition must persist before a repair appears (most types). Default 300 s (5 min).
